mapper.sql: CASE WHEN #{actor.role} = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' OR k.owner_user_id = #{actor.id} THEN 3 ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT max(CASE a.permission WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 3 WHEN 'WRITE' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) FROM knowledge_base_acl a WHERE a.knowledge_base_id = k.id AND ( (a.subject_type = 'USER' AND a.subject_id = CAST(#{actor.id} AS text)) OR (a.subject_type = 'DEPARTMENT' AND a.subject_id = CAST(#{actor.departmentId} AS text)) OR (a.subject_type = 'ROLE' AND a.subject_id = #{actor.role}) ) ), 0) END

SELECT k.id, k.name, k.description, k.department_id, d.name AS department_name, k.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, k.visibility, k.status, k.embedding_model, k.embedding_dimensions, k.generation_model, k.created_at, k.updated_at, CASE (
) WHEN 3 THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN 2 THEN 'WRITE' WHEN 1 THEN 'READ' END AS permission FROM knowledge_base k JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = k.department_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = k.owner_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO knowledge_base(name, description, department_id, owner_user_id, embedding_model, embedding_dimensions, generation_model) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{departmentId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{embeddingModel}, #{embeddingDimensions}, #{generationModel}) RETURNING id

SELECT subject_type, subject_id, permission FROM knowledge_base_acl WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{id} ORDER BY subject_type, subject_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.department_id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted = false AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.deleted = false)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base_acl(knowledge_base_id, subject_type, subject_id, permission) VALUES (#{id}, #{entry.subjectType}, #{entry.subjectId}, #{entry.permission})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET deleted = true WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false

UPDATE knowledge_base SET embedding_model=#{embeddingModel}, embedding_dimensions=#{embeddingDimensions}, generation_model=#{generationModel} WHERE NOT deleted AND (embedding_model IS DISTINCT FROM #{embeddingModel} OR embedding_dimensions IS DISTINCT FROM #{embeddingDimensions} OR generation_model IS DISTINCT FROM #{generationModel})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = false)
